summary: Lipocine Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K on September 16, 2026, disclosing under Item 8.01 that it presented at the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investor Conference held September 14-16, 2026, in New York City, and furnished the accompanying slide presentation as Exhibit 99.1 under Item 9.01. No securities transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is referenced. Lipocine is a clinical-stage pharmaceutical company listed on Nasdaq under LPCN. The filing is an ordinary investor-conference disclosure, not a special situation, and carries no deal terms or risk-arb angle.
